identity_bug_found_and_fixed: the first inventory hashed every non-cached store file, so the identity changed between two consecutive calls (volatile files); the allowlisted inventory is stable
identity_schema: H(schema_version | canonical_path | inventory_digest) over allowlisted security-relevant files (.credentials.json, settings.json, claude.json)
protocol: PHASE A: resolve default store -> identity -> self-consistency; auth status WITHOUT CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR -> principal; empty pinned store -> logged out. PHASE B: pin the canonical default store -> identity(B) == identity(A); retain principal digest(A).
